beats: [d:intrigue][sfx:boom][act:hushed wonder, setting the scene]A ^zigzag, cut into a freshwater mussel shell, on the island of ^Java. [act:slower, let the number land]At least ^four hundred and thirty thousand years ago.
[d:tension][act:the reveal, quiet, amazed][tune:fall]Made by a kind of human that wasn't ^us.

[d:calm][act:plain storytelling]Dug up at Trinil in the {1890s|eighteen nineties}, the shell was looked at again, more than a century later, with ^modern tools. [p:0.93][act:explaining, an everyday picture]Under a microscope, a line cut on purpose looks different from a scratch left by sand or teeth, the way a pen stroke differs from a ^smudge. [act:the finding, clear]This one is a ^deliberate@adj zigzag, engraved with a ^sharp point.

[d:build][go:2|0][act:significant, lean on it]At that time, the only humans on Java were Homo ^erectus, an older kind of human. [p:0.93][act:explaining, the number]Our own species wouldn't appear for well over a hundred thousand ^years.

[d:build][act:recounting the old view, even]Textbooks once said art and symbols exploded ^suddenly, about ^forty thousand years ago, in ^Europe, like a light switched ^on. [sfx:hit][act:flat, final][tune:highfall]That story has ^collapsed. [act:explaining, brisk]Older marks keep turning up, further ^back, and further ^away.

[d:build][act:touring the map, brisk][tune:level]South ^Africa: our own species engraving ^crosshatches on lumps of ^ochre, a red earth used@verb as paint, up to a ^hundred thousand years ago. [go:4|0][act:next stop, same pace][tune:level]The island of ^Sulawesi: a hand stencil. [p:0.93][act:explaining, a simple picture]Press a hand to the rock, blow red paint around it, lift the hand ^away, and its outline stays. [p:0.9][act:the number, slow][tune:fall]This one is at least ^sixty-seven thousand eight hundred years old.

[d:build][go:1|0][act:the last stop, a note of wonder][tune:fall]France: finger lines drawn by ^Neanderthals, our extinct cousins, in a cave sealed shut more than ^fifty-seven thousand years ago. [p:0.93][act:explaining, a simple picture]Like a letter in a sealed ^envelope: whatever is inside went in ^before. [act:pulling back, the big picture]Four places, three continents, three kinds of ^human.
[d:reveal][act:honest caveat, slower]But look at the ^timeline. [act:pointing, careful]'Before our species' rests almost entirely on ^one shell.

[d:build][sfx:shimmer][act:conceding, fair]^Deliberate@adj, yes. [act:wondering aloud][tune:rise]But a ^symbol, with a meaning? [act:lighter, playful][tune:rise]A ^doodle? [act:one more guess][tune:rise]A test of a new ^tool? [gap:0.4][act:honest, quiet, certain][tune:fall]^Nobody knows. [p:0.93][act:explaining, gently]A mark can be deliberate@adj without being a ^message.

[d:verdict][p:0.95][act:weighing it, calm authority][tune:rise]Symbolic marks ^before Homo sapiens? [act:the verdict, level-headed][tune:fall]^*Plausible*. [act:the reason, gentle][tune:fall]^One zigzag doesn't make a ^pattern. [p:0.93][act:practical, clear]A second engraved shell, just as old, would change the ^picture.
[d:tension][p:0.93][act:quiet wonder, the last thought]The urge to leave a mark may be ^older than ^we are.
